solve.reasoning: (A) Force F=qE is parallel to velocity, causing linear acceleration. (B) Force F=qE is constant and perpendicular to initial velocity, resulting in parabolic motion (projectile analogy). (C) Force F=qvBsin(theta) is zero when parallel to B, so the particle moves in a straight line, not a helix. (D) Force F=qvB is constant in magnitude and perpendicular to velocity, causing uniform circular motion.
solve.issues: Option C is incorrect as a particle moving parallel to a magnetic field experiences no force and moves in a straight line, not a helix.
